name: Himbo Hymns EPILOGUE
source:
Yet another day in the life with your lovey-dovey himbo plushie! And he loves you just as much as ever!!

10 days have passed since the Christmas that Mr. Deer came to life. But even in the face of such a miracle, the drag of everyday life continues on... At least you have the sweetest himbo in the world by your side for it!

[From [url=https://lil-beastman.itch.io/himbo-hymns-epilogue]itch.io[/url]]
